# External reference numbers

`facexray_table1_xception.csv`: Xception trained on one FaceForensics++
manipulation (rows) and tested on each (columns), AUC as a fraction.
Transcribed by hand from Li et al., "Face X-ray for More General Face Forgery
Detection", CVPR 2020, Table 1 (arXiv:1912.13458v2), rows "Xception [36]"
with training set = DF / F2F / FS / NT (BI unchecked). Official FF++ data;
the paper does not state the compression level for Table 1 (its Table 4 notes
HQ), nor frame- vs video-level. Note: the same table's HRNet baseline scores
0.3915 on DF->FS.
